scenes.text: Cute. Wrong.

scenes.text: Memory is not a recording — it's a rewrite. Every single time you recall something, your brain rebuilds it from scratch.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Hands rebuilding a film frame whose image is alive.

scenes.text: And here's the part that should scare you: when you're done remembering… it saves the new version. Over the original.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A new reel winding in over an old one that crumbles to dust.

scenes.text: You've never watched the raw footage. The raw footage is gone.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An empty reel, dust where footage should be.

scenes.effective_query: empty film reel dust dark table

scenes.text: So who's doing the editing?

scenes.text: There's an editor living in your head. You never hired him. You've never met him.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The editor from behind at his machine, screen glowing with your childhood.

scenes.text: But he cuts every scene of your life with one job in mind: make you the reasonable one.
